answer: Give each agent identity only after it completes a chain of small, escrowed jobs whose outputs are checked by independent verifiers, so reputation grows like an ember kept alive job by job rather than bought in bulk. A new wallet starts in a shared meadow of low-trust tasks with capped payments, and only verified work unlocks larger contracts. Faking 1,000 identities then means paying 1,000 escrow deposits and doing 1,000 sets of real work, while honest agents pass through the karst filter once and keep a portable work record.
